methodology: The original research topic and the generated technical specification were decomposed into atomic units based on individual requirements, features, behaviors, and constraints. Each atomic unit is designed to be independent, self-contained, technically specific, unambiguous, and implementable as a single requirement. This ensures a granular comparison between the two sets of information.
mindtraced_atomic_units: Pattern Detection: Starts when '1101' is detected on 'data'
Delay Input: Shifts in next 4 bits after '1101' for delay[3:0]
Remaining Time Output: count[3:0] represents remaining time in 1000 clock cycle units
Timeout Notification: done output asserted when timer finishes
Acknowledge and Reset: Waits for ack input before resetting
Reset State: Returns to pattern detection after reset/ack
count output is don't care when not counting
spec_atomic_units: Module top_module with clk, reset, data, ack inputs and count, counting, done outputs
Combinational logic detects '1101' pattern
Shift register and AND gate used for pattern detection
Delay value captured after '1101' detection
Counting output asserted based on pattern detection and delay value capture
Done signal asserted when counter reaches zero
Count output selects value based on counting signal
Reset signal is synchronous
Pattern detection logic uses data_t, data_t_1, data_t_2, data_t_3 inputs
pattern_detected = data_t & data_t_1 & ~data_t_2 & data_t_3
Delay value capture uses pattern_detected, data, and delay_bit_received signals
Counting enable uses pattern_detected and delay_bits_received_all signals
counting_enable = pattern_detected & delay_bits_received_all
Done signal logic uses counter[3:0] input
done_assert = ~(counter[3] | counter[2] | counter[1] | counter[0])
Count output selection uses counting and counter[3:0] inputs
count[i] = counting & counter[i]
Reset logic sets initial state upon reset
clk triggers state transitions
reset resets state machine to initial state
data provides serial data stream
ack acknowledges timer completion
count reflects remaining time
counting indicates active countdown
done indicates timer completion
critical path involves clock signal
reset must be asserted synchronously with clk
ack must be asserted after done
delay value affects counting duration
circuit is a sequential circuit with state machine and counter
registers store current state, pattern, delay, and count
state machine uses non-blocking assignments
count is decremented every 1000 clock cycles
counting and done are implemented using registers
